sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
We move HB-620 to Fonderia Pellice once their audit and PPAP are through.

findings.why: The ASL has controlled HB-620 records for PLT-PIN and CUST-NOR (SUP-D revoked, SUP-H approved) but none for Galvanica Eporediese (SUP-E). Our decision was to move HB-620 to Pellice, not to Eporediese. The supplier has no current approval for this part.

sources.quote: A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y, which is a Nordhavn program. A new casting source is a change of source. It needs Nordhavn's written approval (PPAP) before the first shipment. No approval for this change is in the documents.

The drawing requires EN AC-46000 (MAT-ALSI9CU3) with porosity grade 2 or better (SC-HB620-POR). Galvanica Eporediese is a coater. It has no qualified capability for this material or for die casting. Only SUP-D and SUP-H are qualified.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate for MAT-ALSI9CU3 from SUP-E is on file. This is an open question for the supplier quality engineer (Elena Gallo).
